answer: Verify identities through the post office: the registry mails a one-time code to each claimed address before it can earn. PO boxes and forwarding services are rejected via carrier data, capped at 3 identities per address. Register, wait for the letter, then enter the code within 30 days or the identity freezes. Faking 1,000 accounts needs 1,000 mailboxes at $12 rent plus $4 postage each, about $16,000 and weeks of work, while a real agent pays a stamp. The nebula of fake accounts collapses into a reef of verified homes, each a sonnet delivered to a real door.
